name: What is the difference between framed and frameless kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between framed and frameless kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Framed and frameless refer to the cabinet construction style. Framed cabinets have a face frame around the cabinet opening, similar to a picture frame. This frame adds rigidity and provides a surface for attaching doors and drawers. Frameless cabinets, also known as European style, lack this face frame; doors and drawers attach directly to the cabinet box. Frameless designs offer a sleek, contemporary look and provide more accessible storage space due to the absence of the frame obstruction, while framed cabinets often have a more traditional aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Framed cabinets have a face frame around the opening for rigidity, while frameless (European style) cabinets lack this frame, offering a sleek look and more accessible storage.
